Cycling Attitude-7 Scale

Below are several descriptions of how you may feel. Please use the scale below to rate the degree to which each statement applies to you.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. Cyclists slow down traffic.

_____2. Cycling is a sensible way to commute.

_____3. I would not want a cycle lane on my street.

_____4. I would happily share the road with cyclists.

_____5. Cyclists should pay a road tax.

_____6. Bicycles belong on main roads.

_____7. Cyclists should be allowed on every road.

Scoring:  To compute your score, add your scores for each item as indicated below:

Recode questions 2, 4, & 6 with the following format:
1	=	5
2	=	4
3	=	3
4	=	2
5	=	1

After you have recoded the previous questions, add all of the numbers together to get your composite cycling attitude score.
